restaurants.page_title: Melpis for Restaurants · Automated WhatsApp Table Bookings
restaurants.meta_description: Automate table bookings on WhatsApp 24/7. Shift management, automated no-show reminders, and instant Google Calendar synchronization for dining venues.

hero.title: Fill your tables without pulling your staff away from service
hero.subtitle: Guests message on WhatsApp day and night to reserve a table. Melpis replies instantly, checks seating availability, and locks in the booking on your calendar.

features.title: Shift control and seating capacity
features.desc: Set maximum capacity per seating shift (e.g., 7:30 PM and 9:30 PM) and eliminate double bookings and overcrowded rooms.

features.title: Automated reminders that eliminate no-shows
features.desc: Send friendly WhatsApp reminder messages a few hours before service: guests confirm with a tap or release the table for waitlisted patrons.

features.title: Menus, dietary allergies, and hours
features.desc: Deliver accurate details on gluten-free options, tasting menus, and holiday opening hours directly from your source menu.

beauty.page_title: Melpis for Salons & Barbershops · Automated WhatsApp Bookings
beauty.meta_description: Automate salon bookings on WhatsApp. Staff selection, combined treatments, and automatic reminders without stepping away from the styling chair.

hero.title: Keep your calendar fully booked without stepping away from your clients
hero.subtitle: Stop interrupting haircuts or treatments to answer messages. Melpis schedules appointments, verifies open slots, and proposes alternative times automatically.
hero.cta: Set up your salon in 5 minutes

features.title: Appointments booked by specific stylist
features.desc: Clients can request their favorite stylist or aesthetician, checking individual staff availability in real time.

features.title: Combined treatments and custom durations
features.desc: Automatically calculates total time required for consecutive services like color + blow dry or facial + massage.

features.title: Client re-engagement reminders
features.desc: Send polite check-ins for periodic touch-ups or seasonal treatments while respecting client preferences and privacy.

medical.page_title: Melpis for Medical & Dental Clinics · WhatsApp Front Desk
medical.meta_description: Round-the-clock patient communications for medical and dental clinics. Pre-visit triage, clinic hours, appointment bookings, and dedicated patient privacy.

hero.title: Streamline patient scheduling without overburdening your clinic reception
hero.subtitle: Provide patients with clear guidance on clinic hours, appointment preparation, and visit availability without overwhelming reception staff.

features.title: Pre-visit triage and prep instructions
features.desc: Instantly shares preparation guidelines (such as fasting or required paperwork) and flags urgent requests to clinic staff.

features.title: Strict and confidential handling of health data
features.desc: No sensitive clinical data is ever used to train public language models. End-to-end encryption at rest and in transit.

features.title: Priority handoff to medical reception
features.desc: Complex medical inquiries are immediately routed to front-desk staff with an orderly summary waiting in the Inbox.

hotels.page_title: Melpis for Hotels & Hospitality · 24/7 WhatsApp Guest Concierge
hotels.meta_description: Virtual WhatsApp concierge for boutique hotels and B&Bs. 24/7 instant answers for check-in, amenities, parking, and local attractions.

hero.title: Welcome every guest with five-star service and instant answers before and during their stay
hero.subtitle: Welcome guests before they even arrive. Provide directions, breakfast hours, parking codes, and local tips without congesting the front desk.

features.title: Rapid check-in and arrival guides
features.desc: Send access codes, parking GPS coordinates, and check-in times as soon as a guest booking is confirmed.

features.title: Hotel amenities always at hand
features.desc: Spa schedules, bike rentals, dinner reservations at the in-house restaurant, and late check-out requests handled on the fly.

features.title: Seamless front-desk collaboration
features.desc: Reception staff can take over any guest conversation with one click from any tablet, phone, or computer.
